messages: maya: Quick convo: we need a final pass on the onboarding microcopy + accessibility behavior before we ship the first-run helper. small proposal below. rafael: brief yes from infra—want to avoid heavy client preload. keep metadata minimal. anita: accessibility first: label the opener with aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, and a clear aria-label: "Open Get started helper". announce when opened: "Get started helper opened. 4 steps in checklist." jamie: copy angle: make everything progressive disclosure. Primary CTA label = "Get started". inside, checklist items should be verbs: "Create API key", "Run sample", "Open sample workspace", "Set billing guard". leo: tech: panel should mount in a portal, position fixed, and not cause layout shift. preload only sample thumbnails + IDs (~20KB). actual sample bundles load on run. sarah: microcopy for success states: after run show: "Sample started workspace ready—Open workspace" with a subtle toast. for keyboard users, also announce via polite SR region. maya: localization note: keep strings short to avoid truncation in german/spanish. avoid punctuation-heavy labels. anita: a11y nit: status badges need both text and icon. use visually-hidden text for screen readers: e.g., Complete. Also ensure color contrast 4.5:1 for text on pill. james: (typo fix) i meant jamie earlier :) jamie: tiny UX: add a small "snooze" kebab in the panel header with options 7/30 days + "dismiss forever" for enterprise users. clicking dismiss should write preference to user settings. rafael: telemetry policy: event names: onboarding.helper.open, onboarding.checklist.complete, onboarding.sample.run. no payloads with key material. store only feature flags + step ids. opt-in for failure diagnostics. sarah: keyboard flow: focus order: opener -> panel close control -> checklist item 1 -> run sample -> back to checklist. escape closes and returns focus to opener. trap focus while open. anita: also add a voiceover phrase for each checklist update: "Checklist item 2 complete: Run sample" and role=status updates. test with VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack. leo: rollout: server flag; 5% new accounts -> 25% -> 100% over 3 weeks. measure: time-to-first-sample-run, checklist conversion, and onboarding churn. maya: design asks: can we use a compact horizontal progress indicator at top of panel (step dots + text) vs a vertical checklist? which is clearer? jamie: vertical checklist with inline status is clearer for steps that have actions. progress dots are fine as a summary but not the primary control. sarah: copy tweak: change "Run sample" button to "Run sample (1 click)"? i still think it's noisy. keep it short. maya: agree keep it short. we can add microcopy under the button: "Runs a preconfigured example in your workspace". anita: touch targets >=44px and focus ring 3px minimum. ensure spacing for hit target. rafael: dev tasks: add feature flag, minimal preload endpoint, telemetry endpoints, and server-side rollout API. leo: estimate 3 dev days + 2 QA for a11y testing. maya: next steps: sarah to land copy variants in a PR, anita to write a11y acceptance criteria doc, rafael + leo to schedule rollout and infra pieces. jamie will sketch snooze options in Figma. ux-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/uvw/onboard-a11y-microcopy (preview). maya: thanks team. we'll reconvene after PR lands. any last tiny items? sarah: add a short helper tooltip for the billing step explaining "setting a billing guard prevents unexpected charges". keep it optional. anita: final: include keyboard shortcut discovery in the command palette and list it in the opener aria description. maya: perfect. filing notes into the spec now. :white_check_mark:
